verdict.rationale: Flutterwave is a payments platform with a merchant dashboard, so AI-generated insights from a merchant's own data is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no in-product AI insights or suggestions. The 'smart payment ordering system' is a checkout behavior, and llms.txt is documentation meant for LLM consumption; neither is AI analysis of user data. Both are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
